title: Class 6 UAP shuts down three systems after a directed-energy weapon is aimed at it
place_text: Western United States, hilltop at a government event

tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Jesse Michels, who calls the object a jellyfish UAP and puts it in the 2020s rather than c. 2003.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a UAP disabling Skywatcher's directed-energy weapon before it could fire, at a government event.

as_told.title: Jellyfish UAP shut down a directed energy weapon

plain: Around 2003, on a hilltop in the western United States, an unexplained flying object is said to have shut down three systems after a directed-energy weapon, a weapon that fires focused beams of energy, was aimed at it. The object is called a "class 6" in the story. Someone from Skywatcher, a startup that tries to make UFOs appear on purpose, says they were there. "Somewhere around 2003 we spent the year west," he says, "and we had opportunity to bring for a government event energy weapon." Michels tells it again later, from a man named James Fowler. In his version the object was a jellyfish-shaped craft, it happened in the 2020s, and "it just shut down the directed energy before it even went out." To those who tell it, it shows the objects can switch off our weapons before they are even fired.
